disposition_reason: The results text prints lead, cadmium, aluminum and mercury values (mg/kg) for grilled and fried pork, grilled ram meat and grilled or smoked catfish bought in Calabar; the full metal results are only in a bar chart.

study.design: Cross-sectional sampling of commercially cooked meats and fish (PAHs and metals)
study.market: hotels, roadside vendors, restaurants and Beach market, Calabar Metropolis, Cross River State, Nigeria
study.method: Wet digestion (HNO3 + HClO4) of 0.5 g oven-dried sample; flame AAS (Buck 210 / Perkin Elmer A Analyst 300 named)
study.qa: Calibration standards only; no CRM or recovery reported for metals

unresolved: Chromium values and the remaining aluminum and cadmium values exist only in Figure 1 (bar chart) and were not read.
Results and Discussion disagree on which samples contained lead.
Sampling dates, number of replicates for metals and basis (dry or as eaten) are not stated.
PAH results (Table 4) are not metals and are not recorded.
